verdict.rationale: Kick documents a real double-entry GL (kick-supp-journal-entries), a Chart of Accounts, and an MCP/CLI interface that lets an AI 'query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping' (kick-docs-16, kick-docs-15), plus a Tax Package Excel export (kick-docs-9/20) — giving some programmatic and open-format access to financial data. However, there is no documented REST/OpenAPI spec (probe of openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s at kick-probe-2), and no explicit mention of a 'trial balance' report or a dedicated GL export endpoint in open formats like CSV/JSON. Missing for 10: a documented public API (OpenAPI/REST) beyond MCP, an explicit trial-balance report/export, and confirmation that GL data can be pulled in structured open formats (CSV/JSON) via that API.
